summary.text: Valerie McDonnell is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Valerie McDonnell's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2022.
